text:
starts_with
Description
Tests if one string starts_with another string
Syntax
<
string1
>
starts_with
<
string2
>
<string1> starts_with <string2>
Tests if string1 starts with string2.
Equivalent to the
TCL string match
command
:
string
match
string2
*
string1
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
path
]
ends_with
"cgi"
}
{
pool
cgi_pool
}
elseif
{
[
HTTP
::
path
]
starts_with
"/abc"
}
{
pool
abc_servers
}
}
